description: Stage 1 re-measurement of the v9 Theta surface on the repaired engine. THETA-SCREEN-V9 (0fb186b) was measured with post-clearance reinfection active: cleared hosts were immediately susceptible again and infections_total / the truth channel could count second episodes. REINFECT-01 (#636, d62f10d) gives every cleared host the declared 90-day refractory window and episode-keeping infection records, so no second episode is possible on a <=35-day voyage. Every Theta-conditioned conclusion upstream of that fix (v7, v9, the change-detector pins, the 'no near-critical band' finding) is therefore measured on an engine that no longer exists, and QUAR-ATTR-V2 showed the fix moves the truth channel materially (A0 seed 20200205: Theta 1e9 infections_total 3458, attack 0.9318 at d62f10d). This screen is the v9 design with the infection-age axis removed and nothing else changed: the same ten decade Theta from 1e1 to 1e10, the same 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, the same frozen v9 admissibility block, the same worker payload -- 200 cells on diamond_princess_2020, each pairing by (Theta, seed) with a v9 cell so the two surfaces read side by side per Theta (takeoff fraction, conditional attack-rate quantiles, covid.T1/T4 verdicts, vsp_threshold_crossing_fraction). It is a re-measurement, not a fit and not a refinement: no Theta on it may be quoted as fitted, and the canary (Theta 1e9, all 20 seeds) must reproduce the QUAR-ATTR-V2 A0 cell of record exactly at the shared seed before the remaining 180 cells run.
supersedes: covid_theta_screen_v9 as the Theta surface of record once this surface is read out; v9 stays valid as the pre-REINFECT-01 measurement at 0fb186b and is not re-run there
prerequisites: DOSE-FRAIL-01 (#603): Theta scales the per-host beta-Poisson frailty draw; mean host susceptibility = Theta.
INDEX-GEOM-01 (#605): declared per-agent departure; the diamond_princess_2020 index seed carries departure_day 5.0.
SEED-ONSET-01 (#609): ExplicitSeed.onset_day; the diamond_princess_2020 index seed carries onset_day -1.0 and boards symptomatic by construction.

THETA-SCREEN-V8 (#610, #613): the declared-onset invariant is confirmed end-to-end on real cells (index_onset_day == -1.0, index_shedding_at_day0 true, index_departed_epoch 120), and the v8 grid was measured to sit in saturation. v8 was never submitted.

THETA-SCREEN-V9 (#615, measured at 0fb186b): the infection-age axis is inert under a declared onset_day (200 of 200 (Theta, seed) triples byte-identical across 3.3 / 6.8 / 12.8 d); Theta moves takeoff probability, not outbreak size; the sole covid.T1 pass at Theta 1e9 was an interval-span with onset_mass_near_target 0.00.

QUAR-EXEMPT-01 (#633): exempt_classes scoped to the protocol that declares them; the declared Diamond Princess replay at HEAD is a different trajectory from the committed v9 surface for this reason as well.
REINFECT-01 (#636, d62f10d): declared 90-day refractory window after clearance, episode-keeping infection records; the truth channel counts first infections. The reason this screen exists.

QUAR-ATTR-V2 (#638, measured at d62f10d): canary cell of record, arm A0_declared, seed 20200205 -- Theta 1e5: infections_total 950, attack_rate 0.2560, before/during/after quarantine 745-198-7; Theta 1e9: 3458, 0.9318, 3414-43-1. The v10 cells at (1e5, 20200205) and (1e9, 20200205) must reproduce these inside the campaign image.
thetas_note: Verbatim from v9: ten decade steps, 1e1 to 1e10. The lattice is kept identical so every v10 cell pairs with a v9 cell at the same (Theta, seed) and the per-Theta side-by-side is a paired reading, not a comparison of two grids. The 1e1 floor was inert in v9 and is expected to stay inert; the 1e10 ceiling is retained so the whole v7/v8/v9 region stays readable. If the admissible set sits on either boundary it is a boundary and must be reported as one, never selected on.
infection_age_note: Single value, and it is NOT an axis. THETA-SCREEN-V9 measured that under the scenario's declared onset_day = -1.0 the infection age cancels exactly in engines/initiation.py::_apply_one_seed (incubation = age + onset_day - seed_day, history stamped from elapsed_since_onset = 1.0 d): 200 of 200 (Theta, seed) triples were byte-identical across 3.3 / 6.8 / 12.8 d outside the cell block. The axis is dropped; 3.3 is carried because it is the value covid_quarantine_attribution_v1 carried, so the v10 cell keys and run specs match the QUAR-ATTR-V2 A0 cells exactly (screen_diamond_princess_2020_theta1e9p00_age3p3d_imports1_seed20200205, minus the arm suffix). The worker still writes the value into the seed record (apply_boarding_axis); the local smoke must show it is inert -- the same trajectory at any age -- rather than absent from the spec.
seeds_note: The SAME 20 matched seeds as v9 and QUAR-ATTR-V2 at the same base, so every cell pairs with its v9 cell and the Theta 1e9 canary pairs seed-for-seed with the QUAR-ATTR-V2 A0 arm.
cells_note: 10 Theta x 1 age x 1 import x 20 seeds. Authored as a refinement (explicit points, parent_design covid_theta_screen_v9) for the same reason v9 was: a declared onset_day = -1.0 makes the root grid's infection-age-0 baseline a load-time contradiction.

cell_payload_additions.note: Unchanged from v7 and v9: the same worker fields, so the three surfaces are read the same way. No arm block: this design declares no arms, so the QUAR-ATTR attribution keys are not written.
cell_payload_additions.index_onset_day: Voyage day of the seeded index host's symptom onset. Under a declared onset this must equal -1.0 in every cell; a cell where it does not is a defect in the seeding path, not a failed criterion.
cell_payload_additions.index_shedding_at_day0: Whether the seeded host's shedding curve is above zero at epoch 0. True by construction here: the host is one day past onset at boarding.
cell_payload_additions.index_departed_epoch: The epoch the seeded host left the ship, echoed from the run for audit.
cell_payload_additions.infections_total: Truth-channel count of hosts ever infected, index excluded.
cell_payload_additions.vsp_reported_case_fraction_max: Maximum over epochs of the engine's reported passenger case fraction, for the cross-pathogen readout against the 3% VSP threshold; recorded, not thresholded, in the worker.

admissibility.note: FROZEN: carried verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v9, thresholds and diagnostics included, before any v10 cell exists. Nothing is loosened and nothing is tightened; a re-measurement on a repaired engine that changed its criteria would not be readable against the surface it re-measures. Pre-declared before any v9 cell exists. covid.T1 and the index-geometry invariant are carried over verbatim from v8, thresholds included; nothing is loosened, and widening the Theta range downward is not a loosening -- it screens Theta space the earlier grids never visited, for a reason measured and recorded before this design was written (THETA-SCREEN-V8). Bimodality is NOT a failure criterion and its absence is not a success criterion: covid.H3 records a median voyage attack rate of 0.2% with Diamond Princess at 712 cases, so the real fleet IS near-critical. The question is whether one Theta puts typical voyages at the fleet median while leaving the Diamond Princess trajectory in the tail.

index_geometry.criterion: AUDIT INVARIANT, not a selection filter: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in 100% of every cell's seeds.
index_geometry.reads: the seeded host's own onset and shedding record
index_geometry.note: Under SEED-ONSET-01 the onset day is stamped from the record rather than drawn, so any deviation is a seeding-path defect and invalidates the cell rather than excluding it from selection. The v7 criterion (80% of seeds) is retired: it was a threshold on a lottery the model should never have been running.

covid_T1.criterion: The cell's 10th-to-90th percentile interval of recorded_onsets across seeds contains 197, AND |before_share - 0.173| <= 0.10 for the cell's median before_share, where before_share = onsets_before_split_day / recorded_onsets and 0.173 = 34/197 (onsets before day 17, 6 February).
covid_T1.note: Verbatim from v7 and v8, thresholds included. This is the selection criterion. It is known to be weak in one specific way, measured off the v7 surface and recorded in THETA-SCREEN-V8 before this design was written: all eleven v7 T1-passing cells passed by their 10th-to-90th interval SPANNING 197 from an extinction floor (recorded_onsets p10 = 0) to a burn ceiling (p90 316 to 3,405), with attack q50 = 0.0000 in seven of them. The criterion is deliberately NOT rewritten here -- rewriting a criterion because a surface disappointed is the thing that must never happen -- but onset_mass_near_target below is reported alongside it so a pass can be read as mass-near-197 or as interval-spanning-197. A stage-1b design may tighten T1 using that diagnostic, declared before its own cells run.

covid_T3_diagnostic.criterion: Reported, never used in selection: the cell's campaign_positives interval against 634 and median campaign_specimens against 3,063.
covid_T3_diagnostic.note: Demoted on v7's evidence, before any v8 cell ran: median campaign specimens ran 1,598 to 3,063 and conditional-on-takeoff median positives 66 to 872 across five decades of Theta, and T3 was passed in sixteen scattered cells whose attack rates differ by a factor of three. On this hull the testing campaign saturates against its own day capacities well before the epidemic does, so T3 measures assay capacity, not transmission.

covid_T2_diagnostic.criterion: Reported, never used in selection: direction of the passenger and crew onset turn in the 7 days after day 16.

covid_T4_diagnostic.criterion: Reported, never used in selection: asymptomatic share among positives, target 0.5047.
covid_T4_diagnostic.note: v7 measured this share capping at 0.43 anywhere on the surface and falling as Theta rises, because in this model it is emergent from delivered dose rather than a natural-history parameter. It cannot be met by a choice of Theta and is recorded here so the mismatch is tracked rather than silently reselected against.

fleet_shape_indicator.criterion: Reported per cell, not thresholded at stage 1: P(attack_rate <= 0.01), the takeoff fraction (seeds reaching takeoff_recorded_onsets), P(attack_rate >= 0.10), and attack_rate quantiles at 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9. The held-out covid.H3 shape (most voyages extinguishing, a minority burning) is what stage 2 tests; at stage 1 these are the indicator that a T1-passing cell is near-critical rather than deterministic.

burn_tail.criterion: Reported per cell, not thresholded. The real Diamond Princess attack was 712/3711 = 0.19 under an intervention schedule the scenario reproduces; a cell whose attack-rate 10th-90th interval excludes 0.19 entirely is reported as such.

admissibility.selection: The admissible set is every cell passing covid_T1 whose index-geometry invariant holds. If it is empty, the readout reports the nearest cells, the located band, and states that no admissible Theta exists on this arm; no criterion is loosened after the fact. If it is non-empty, stage 1b refines the band at half-decade steps with 40 seeds and the interior incubation points restored, and only then do stage 2 (fleet shape) and stage 3 (held-out hull) run on its output. On this re-measurement a change in the admissible set against v9 is attributed to REINFECT-01 (the only engine change between the two surfaces besides QUAR-EXEMPT-01, which THETA-SCREEN-V9 already attributed at the 1e5 witness cell), not to Theta.

onset_mass_near_target_diagnostic.criterion: Reported, never used in selection at stage 1: the fraction of a cell's seeds whose recorded_onsets lies within a factor of two of the observed 197 (that is, in [98, 394] inclusive), and the full per-seed recorded_onsets vector so the distribution can be read rather than summarised.
onset_mass_near_target_diagnostic.note: New in v9 and diagnostic by declaration. It exists because a T1 pass driven by an interval spanning 197 and a T1 pass driven by seeds landing near 197 are different evidential objects, and v7 could not tell them apart. Recorded, not thresholded: no cell is admitted or excluded on this quantity at stage 1.

v9_side_by_side.note: The readout (docs/covid/covid_theta_screen_v10_readout.md) reports, per Theta, v9 and v10 side by side: takeoff fraction, attack-rate quantiles conditional on takeoff, covid.T1 and covid.T4 verdicts, vsp_threshold_crossing_fraction, and the per-seed recorded_onsets vectors. The open ledger then marks which v9 verdicts are superseded. Expected: an equal-or-lower truth channel per cell (no second episodes can be counted), the same or a lower attack rate; a Theta that shows takeoff where v9 showed none, or vice versa, outside a 2/20 seed band is reported immediately.

stage_2_fleet_shape.status: designed, not submitted until stage 1 closes; its Theta list is stage 1's output
stage_2_fleet_shape.introduction: one host at boarding with infection age drawn from the profile's incubation distribution and NO declared onset -- a typical voyage's introduction is not a dated case report, so onset_day is left unset here and the incubation is drawn, exactly as the channel does without SEED-ONSET-01
stage_2_fleet_shape.criterion: Across the 200 voyages: median recorded attack rate within [0.0005, 0.008], interquartile range overlapping [0.0003, 0.015], mean not above 0.06.
stage_2_fleet_shape.note: Unchanged from v7. An approximation and declared as one: the model has one hull, not 79, so what is compared is the SHAPE of the across-voyage distribution, never a ship-specific value. The comparison numerator is RECORDED cases, not the truth channel. H3 is held out: this stage may refuse a Theta stage 1 admitted, but may never pick among Thetas stage 1 admitted.

stage_3_held_out.status: designed, not submitted until stages 1 and 2 close
stage_3_held_out.note: Scored once at the selected Theta and reported at its half-decade neighbours as sensitivity. The Greg Mortimer seed declares no onset day -- no retrieved source dates that index's onset -- so its incubation is drawn, and its geometry is not an invariant there. A miss here is a result to record, not a reason to reopen the grid.

cross_pathogen_readout.note: Recorded for comparison with the norovirus arm running the same hull: per cell, the fraction of runs whose vsp_reported_case_fraction_max reaches 0.03 and the attack-rate quantiles conditioned on reaching it. Same ship, different observable; neither arm constrains the other's Theta.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot, per .agents/skills/aws-batch-campaign/SKILL.md, via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_theta_screen_v10. The image must be built from a main that contains this design file: the design is read inside the container.
execution.canary: Theta 1e9, all 20 seeds (20 cells, array indices 160..179 in enumeration order), inspected before the remaining 180 cells: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in every cell; the (1e9, 20200205) cell reproduces the QUAR-ATTR-V2 A0 cell of record exactly; takeoff fraction and conditional attack read against v9's Theta 1e9 row. Stop and report; the user decides whether the remaining cells run.

stage_1b_refinement.note: The v9 stage_1b block (half-decade, 40-seed, six-age refinement) is withdrawn: covid_quarantine_attribution_v1 already recorded that two of its three axes are void (age inert; no near-critical band on the v9 surface). Whether a refinement exists at all is decided from this surface, in its own design file, before its cells run.
